conventions.indexHash: SHA256 over original packed indices, in source order; diamond exactly 900 bytes, extra width*height bytes.
conventions.diamondAlpha: All 900 encoded diamond pixels are opaque, including palette index 0; outside the shape is transparent black. Last row is empty.
conventions.extraAlpha: Index 0 is transparent black; other extra pixels are opaque. Extra is a separate layer, not composited onto the diamond.
conventions.offset: Raw signed top-left pixel coordinates from block header, relative to template origin; unmodified.
conventions.gridOffset: Isometric top-left implied by table cell: ((cellX-cellY)*30, (cellX+cellY)*15).
conventions.heightAdjustedOffset: Raw offset with Y += (template.maxHeight - height)*15, per ra2ff description; supplied separately, no resampling.
conventions.extraOffset: Raw template pixel coordinates; offsetFromDiamond = extra.offset - diamond.offset. Same height adjustment as base.
conventions.terrainType: Raw block terrain index byte; theater tile-set IDs and terrain name/rules mappings are not present in a standalone TMP.
conventions.zData: Raw depth bytes preserved; no claims about renderer depth or damaged-data semantics.

warnings: Extra flag is clear: unused extra pointer fields are retained, not dereferenced.
